religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore): Lawful venerates the Lawful powers and names the Chaotic as demons; Chaotic the reverse; Neutral honors ancestral and local powers, invoking the great powers situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Zarhua — cosmopolitan merchant oligarchy of the synthesis; law, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Zarhua are a vigorous merchant oligarchy people, a first-order synthesis of Aryastan and Huaxia [Peer Synthesis / Mercantile]. They prize law, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field archers, heavy_cavalry, heavy_infantry. Outsiders are met as cosmopolitan; their patrons touch war.
